svg.title: DC-PicoLink perfboard wiring
svg.text: A5 purple RTS (plug pin 6) to GP12
A6 blue RXD (plug pin 4) to GP11
A9 red TXD (plug pin 5) to GP10
A10 orange CTS (plug pin 7) to GP9
red 5V gray GND coral 3.3V sense amber 3V3 blue SD green Zero-ESP link purple Dreamcast serial
Front view, wires run on the back. R = 10k at H2-I2, D = 1N5819 at H1 (anode) to I1 (bar). A7, A8: no wire.
Dreamcast plug, front (SD slot at the bottom): pin, signal, wire
Dreamcast plug, back (FFC connector at the bottom)
JST housings: pin 1 is the one nearest the board edge (3-pin) or nearest the 3-pin (6-pin)
